description: Root object for the lesson.json data structure. All fields inside are optional, but there can't be other fields than the ones specified here.

lesson_date.description: The date of the lesson (e.g., '19-02-2026'). Stored as a string.

due_date.description: The due date for the lesson's assignment. Stored as a string.

num_hours.description: The duration of the lesson in hours. Can be an integer (2) or float (2.5).

external_links.description: A list of external resources and videos. Can be completely omitted or empty.

items.description: Each item in the array must be an object representing a link.

title.description: The text title describing the link.
